name: motif_add_phonological_feature
description:
Author a phonological feature. Research first: motif_guide topic nasal-assimilation or archiphonemes; check best practice. Use only if rules or natural classes need a phonological feature of sounds; otherwise use compose-author-inflection-feature for grammar, or compose-author-exception-feature for a stem list (guide archiphonemes). Stages a closed phonological feature and its values in the project's phonological feature system, such as place with labial, coronal and velar. Phonemes carry the values and a natural class can be defined by them. Defining the first feature of a featureless project changes how rewrite rules that name segment classes are read, so Trial the rules after it. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-author-phonological-feature. Agent class: Draft.

abbreviation.description: Optional feature abbreviation, unique among phonological features.

values.description: Nonempty list of values, each an object with a name and an optional abbreviation; select one later in a batch with @label:values:NAME.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
